translations.web: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
translations.bsb: If you cease to hear instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
translations.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
translations.asv: Cease, my son, to hear instruction Only to err from the words of knowledge.
